The FloPlast push-fit air admittance valve is an essential component for sanitary pipework and soil and vent systems, efficiently managing air pressure by allowing air into the drainage system whilst preventing foul odours from escaping into buildings. This 110mm black valve is ideal for internal plumbing installations where external roof penetration for ventilation is impractical or undesirable, ensuring a clean aesthetic. Its robust uPVC construction and simple push-fit connection simplify fitting for plumbers and drainage professionals. Engineered to operate reliably between -20° and +60°C without additional insulation, it boasts a high 42.3 Ltr/sec air flow capacity. The design permits installation below the flood level of connected appliances, offering flexible plumbing solutions. Remove seal from 110mm push-fit for 82mm solvent connection.
